chat_messages.text: Should the web app use JWTs or server-side sessions? It's a single Next.js frontend talking to our API.

content.text: With one first-party frontend, server-side sessions are simpler and safer: you can revoke them instantly and keep tokens out of JavaScript. JWTs shine when many services verify tokens independently.

chat_messages.text: We chose server-side sessions instead of JWT because we need instant logout and only have one frontend.

The login page crashes:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'user')
The problem is the session is undefined on the first render, before the fetch resolves. Guard it with optional chaining: session?.user, and render a loading state until the session request finishes.
Works now. Still need to add CSRF protection to the session cookie.
